tool_input.sql:
CALL SYSTEM$CREATE_SEMANTIC_VIEW_FROM_YAML(
  'KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.PORTFOLIO_ANALYTICS_AGENT',
  $$
name: RIA_PORTFOLIO_ANALYTICS
description: RIA Portfolio Analytics for wealth management - clients, advisors, accounts, securities, returns, valuations

tables:
  - name: dim_client
    base_table:
      database: KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY
      schema: GOLD
      table: DIM_CLIENT
    description: Client dimension with demographics, wealth segmentation, risk profile, and primary advisor
    primary_key:
      columns:
        - client_id
    dimensions:
      - name: client_id
        expr: CLIENT_ID
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique client identifier
        unique: true
      - name: client_name
        expr: CLIENT_NAME
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Full name of the client
      - name: state
        expr: STATE
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Client state of residence
      - name: city
        expr: CITY
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Client city
      - name: account_type
        expr: ACCOUNT_TYPE
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account entity type such as Individual, Household, Joint, Trust
      - name: client_segment
        expr: CLIENT_SEGMENT
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Wealth segment such as HNW, UHNW, Mass Affluent, Institutional
        is_enum: true
      - name: service_model
        expr: SERVICE_MODEL
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Service delivery tier
      - name: risk_tolerance
        expr: RISK_TOLERANCE
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Risk tolerance profile such as Conservative, Moderate, Aggressive
        is_enum: true
      - name: investment_experience
        expr: INVESTMENT_EXPERIENCE
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Investment knowledge level
      - name: relationship_start_date
        expr: RELATIONSHIP_START_DATE
        data_type: DATE
        description: Date the advisory relationship began
    metrics:
      - name: total_clients
        expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CLIENT_ID)
        description: Count of distinct clients
      - name: client_total_aum
        expr: SUM(TOTAL_AUM)
        description: Total AUM across all client accounts
      - name: avg_client_aum
        expr: AVG(TOTAL_AUM)
        description: Average AUM per client

  - name: dim_advisor
    base_table:
      database: KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY
      schema: GOLD
      table: DIM_ADVISOR
    description: Advisor dimension with role, team, region, credentials, and book metrics
    primary_key:
      columns:
        - advisor_id
    dimensions:
      - name: advisor_id
        expr: ADVISOR_ID
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique advisor identifier
        unique: true
      - name: advisor_name
        expr: ADVISOR_NAME
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Full name of the financial advisor
      - name: advisor_role
        expr: ROLE
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advisor role such as Lead Advisor or Senior Advisor
      - name: rep_code
        expr: REP_CODE
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advisor rep code
      - name: branch
        expr: BRANCH
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Office branch name
      - name: advisor_is_active
        expr: IS_ACTIVE
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Whether the advisor is currently active
      - name: team_name
        expr: TEAM_NAME
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advisory team name
      - name: region
        expr: REGION
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Geographic region
    metrics:
      - name: total_advisors
        expr: COUNT(DISTINCT ADVISOR_ID)
        description: Count of distinct advisors
      - name: advisor_total_aum
        expr: SUM(TOTAL_AUM)
        description: Total AUM across advisor book of business
      - name: advisor_avg_client_count
        expr: AVG(CLIENT_COUNT)
        description: Average number of clients per advisor

  - name: dim_account
    base_table:
      database: KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY
      schema: GOLD
      table: DIM_ACCOUNT
    description: Account dimension with registration type, custodian, model assignment, and status
    primary_key:
      columns:
        - financial_account_id
    dimensions:
      - name: financial_account_id
        expr: FINANCIAL_ACCOUNT_ID
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique financial account identifier
        unique: true
      - name: account_number
        expr: ACCOUNT_NUMBER
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Custodian-assigned account number
      - name: account_name
        expr: ACCOUNT_NAME
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Display name of the account
      - name: registration_type
        expr: REGISTRATION_TYPE
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Legal registration type such as Individual, Joint, Trust, Custodial
      - name: dim_account_type
        expr: ACCOUNT_TYPE
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account type such as Brokerage, IRA, 401k, Trust
      - name: account_status
        expr: STATUS
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Current account status
      - name: custodian_code
        expr: CUSTODIAN_CODE
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Custodian platform code such as SCHW, PERS, FIDL
        is_enum: true
      - name: inception_date
        expr: INCEPTION_DATE
        data_type: DATE
        description: Date the account was opened
      - name: fee_schedule
        expr: FEE_SCHEDULE
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Fee schedule tier
      - name: model_id
        expr: MODEL_ID
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Assigned model portfolio identifier
      - name: account_is_discretionary
        expr: IS_DISCRETIONARY
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Whether the account has discretionary authority
      - name: acct_client_id
        expr: CLIENT_ID
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Client foreign key
      - name: acct_advisor_id
        expr: ADVISOR_ID
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advisor foreign key
    metrics:
      - name: total_accounts
        expr: COUNT(DISTINCT FINANCIAL_ACCOUNT_ID)
        description: Count of distinct financial accounts
      - name: avg_fee_rate
        expr: AVG(FEE_RATE)
        description: Average management fee rate

  - name: fct_account_value
    base_table:
      database: KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY
      schema: GOLD
      table: FCT_ACCOUNT_VALUE
    description: Current account value snapshot with market value, model allocation, latest returns, and holdings
    primary_key:
      columns:
        - financial_account_id
    dimensions:
      - name: fct_financial_account_id
        expr: FINANCIAL_ACCOUNT_ID
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Financial account foreign key
      - name: fct_client_id
        expr: CLIENT_ID
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Client foreign key
      - name: fct_advisor_id
        expr: ADVISOR_ID
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advisor foreign key
      - name: model_name
        expr: MODEL_NAME
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Model portfolio name
      - name: risk_profile
        expr: RISK_PROFILE
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Model risk profile such as Conservative, Moderate, Growth, Aggressive
        is_enum: true
      - name: benchmark_name
        expr: BENCHMARK_NAME
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Benchmark used for comparison
      - name: return_as_of_date
        expr: RETURN_AS_OF_DATE
        data_type: DATE
        description: Date of the latest return calculation
    facts:
      - name: market_value
        expr: MARKET_VALUE
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Total market value of the account
      - name: equity_target_pct
        expr: EQUITY_TARGET_PCT
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Model target equity allocation percentage
      - name: fixed_income_target_pct
        expr: FIXED_INCOME_TARGET_PCT
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Model target fixed income allocation percentage
      - name: mtd_return
        expr: MTD_RETURN
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Month-to-date return
      - name: ytd_return
        expr: YTD_RETURN
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Year-to-date return
      - name: one_year_return
        expr: ONE_YEAR_RETURN
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Trailing 1-year return
      - name: mtd_excess_return
        expr: MTD_EXCESS_RETURN
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: MTD alpha vs benchmark
      - name: ytd_excess_return
        expr: YTD_EXCESS_RETURN
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: YTD alpha vs benchmark
      - name: holding_count
        expr: HOLDING_COUNT
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Number of distinct holdings
      - name: holdings_market_value
        expr: HOLDINGS_MARKET_VALUE
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Sum of position market values
      - name: total_unrealized_gain_loss
        expr: TOTAL_UNREALIZED_GAIN_LOSS
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Unrealized gain or loss across all positions
    metrics:
      - name: total_aum
        expr: SUM(MARKET_VALUE)
        description: Total assets under management
      - name: avg_market_value
        expr: AVG(MARKET_VALUE)
        description: Average account market value
      - name: avg_ytd_return
        expr: AVG(YTD_RETURN)
        description: Average YTD return across accounts
      - name: avg_ytd_excess
        expr: AVG(YTD_EXCESS_RETURN)
        description: Average YTD excess return vs benchmark
      - name: total_unrealized_gl
        expr: SUM(TOTAL_UNREALIZED_GAIN_LOSS)
        description: Total unrealized gain or loss

  - name: fct_portfolio_return
    base_table:
      database: KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY
      schema: GOLD
      table: FCT_PORTFOLIO_RETURN
    description: Monthly portfolio return fact with benchmark comparison and excess returns
    primary_key:
      columns:
        - return_key
    dimensions:
      - name: ret_account_number
        expr: ACCOUNT_NUMBER
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account number foreign key
      - name: as_of_date
        expr: AS_OF_DATE
        data_type: DATE
        description: Return period end date
      - name: ret_client_id
        expr: CLIENT_ID
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Client foreign key
      - name: ret_advisor_id
        expr: ADVISOR_ID
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advisor foreign key
      - name: ret_benchmark_name
        expr: BENCHMARK_NAME
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Benchmark name
      - name: return_method
        expr: RETURN_METHOD
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: TWR or IRR
      - name: ret_client_segment
        expr: CLIENT_SEGMENT
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Client segment at time of return
    facts:
      - name: ret_mtd_return
        expr: MTD_RETURN
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Month-to-date return
      - name: ret_ytd_return
        expr: YTD_RETURN
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Year-to-date return
      - name: ret_one_year_return
        expr: ONE_YEAR_RETURN
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Trailing 1-year return
      - name: ret_benchmark_mtd_return
        expr: BENCHMARK_MTD_RETURN
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Benchmark MTD return
      - name: ret_mtd_excess_return
        expr: MTD_EXCESS_RETURN
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: MTD alpha vs benchmark
      - name: ret_ytd_excess_return
        expr: YTD_EXCESS_RETURN
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: YTD alpha vs benchmark
    metrics:
      - name: avg_monthly_return
        expr: AVG(MTD_RETURN)
        description: Average monthly portfolio return
      - name: avg_monthly_excess
        expr: AVG(MTD_EXCESS_RETURN)
        description: Average monthly alpha vs benchmark
      - name: avg_ytd_portfolio_return
        expr: AVG(YTD_RETURN)
        description: Average YTD portfolio return

relationships:
  - name: fct_account_value_to_dim_client
    left_table: fct_account_value
    right_table: dim_client
    relationship_columns:
      - left_column: fct_client_id
        right_column: client_id
  - name: fct_account_value_to_dim_advisor
    left_table: fct_account_value
    right_table: dim_advisor
    relationship_columns:
      - left_column: fct_advisor_id
        right_column: advisor_id
  - name: fct_account_value_to_dim_account
    left_table: fct_account_value
    right_table: dim_account
    relationship_columns:
      - left_column: fct_financial_account_id
        right_column: financial_account_id
  - name: fct_portfolio_return_to_dim_account
    left_table: fct_portfolio_return
    right_table: dim_account
    relationship_columns:
      - left_column: ret_account_number
        right_column: account_number
  - name: fct_portfolio_return_to_dim_client
    left_table: fct_portfolio_return
    right_table: dim_client
    relationship_columns:
      - left_column: ret_client_id
        right_column: client_id
  - name: fct_portfolio_return_to_dim_advisor
    left_table: fct_portfolio_return
    right_table: dim_advisor
    relationship_columns:
      - left_column: ret_advisor_id
        right_column: advisor_id
  - name: dim_account_to_dim_client
    left_table: dim_account
    right_table: dim_client
    relationship_columns:
      - left_column: acct_client_id
        right_column: client_id
  - name: dim_account_to_dim_advisor
    left_table: dim_account
    right_table: dim_advisor
    relationship_columns:
      - left_column: acct_advisor_id
        right_column: advisor_id

verified_queries:
  - name: top_clients_by_aum
    question: Who are the top 10 clients by market value?
    sql: |
      SELECT c.CLIENT_NAME, c.CLIENT_SEGMENT, f.MARKET_VALUE, f.YTD_RETURN, f.MODEL_NAME
      FROM KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.GOLD.FCT_ACCOUNT_VALUE f
      JOIN KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.GOLD.DIM_CLIENT c ON c.CLIENT_ID = f.CLIENT_ID
      ORDER BY f.MARKET_VALUE DESC NULLS LAST
      LIMIT 10
    verified_at: 1727600000
    verified_by: keith.evans
  - name: advisors_ranked_by_aum
    question: Show all advisors ranked by total AUM
    sql: |
      SELECT ADVISOR_NAME, TEAM_NAME, REGION, CLIENT_COUNT, TOTAL_AUM
      FROM KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.GOLD.DIM_ADVISOR
      ORDER BY TOTAL_AUM DESC
    verified_at: 1727600000
    verified_by: keith.evans
  - name: aum_by_segment
    question: What is the total AUM and average YTD return by client segment?
    sql: |
      SELECT c.CLIENT_SEGMENT,
             COUNT(DISTINCT c.CLIENT_ID) AS CLIENT_COUNT,
             SUM(f.MARKET_VALUE) AS TOTAL_AUM,
             AVG(f.YTD_RETURN) AS AVG_YTD_RETURN
      FROM KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.GOLD.FCT_ACCOUNT_VALUE f
      JOIN KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.GOLD.DIM_CLIENT c ON c.CLIENT_ID = f.CLIENT_ID
      GROUP BY c.CLIENT_SEGMENT
      ORDER BY TOTAL_AUM DESC
    verified_at: 1727600000
    verified_by: keith.evans
  - name: performance_by_risk_profile
    question: How are accounts performing by risk profile?
    sql: |
      SELECT RISK_PROFILE,
             COUNT(*) AS ACCOUNT_COUNT,
             AVG(MARKET_VALUE) AS AVG_MARKET_VALUE,
             AVG(YTD_RETURN) AS AVG_YTD_RETURN,
             AVG(YTD_EXCESS_RETURN) AS AVG_EXCESS
      FROM KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.GOLD.FCT_ACCOUNT_VALUE
      GROUP BY RISK_PROFILE
      ORDER BY AVG_MARKET_VALUE DESC
    verified_at: 1727600000
    verified_by: keith.evans
  - name: worst_ytd_accounts
    question: Which accounts have the worst YTD performance?
    sql: |
      SELECT a.ACCOUNT_NAME, a.REGISTRATION_TYPE, a.CUSTODIAN_CODE,
             f.MARKET_VALUE, f.YTD_RETURN, f.HOLDING_COUNT
      FROM KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.GOLD.FCT_ACCOUNT_VALUE f
      JOIN KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.GOLD.DIM_ACCOUNT a ON a.FINANCIAL_ACCOUNT_ID = f.FINANCIAL_ACCOUNT_ID
      WHERE f.YTD_RETURN < 0
      ORDER BY f.YTD_RETURN ASC
      LIMIT 20
    verified_at: 1727600000
    verified_by: keith.evans
  - name: monthly_returns_trend
    question: Show me monthly average portfolio return vs benchmark over time
    sql: |
      SELECT AS_OF_DATE,
             AVG(MTD_RETURN) AS AVG_PORTFOLIO_RETURN,
             AVG(BENCHMARK_MTD_RETURN) AS AVG_BENCHMARK_RETURN,
             AVG(MTD_EXCESS_RETURN) AS AVG_EXCESS_RETURN
      FROM KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.GOLD.FCT_PORTFOLIO_RETURN
      GROUP BY AS_OF_DATE
      ORDER BY AS_OF_DATE
    verified_at: 1727600000
    verified_by: keith.evans
$$
);
